text: At flock level, active chickens with bright feathers and good body development signal good health. Finding dead chickens still in good body condition should immediately raise suspicion of an acute disease killing birds quickly, such as Avian Influenza or Newcastle Disease. Healthy birds stand erect, active, and alert; birds that stay apart, look dull, and are easy to catch are likely sick. Backyard chickens need strong legs to scavenge — lameness from injury (common in scavenging birds) stops them finding enough feed, and without treatment they lose condition and become easy targets for predators.
